name: Schuko (CEE 7/3, CEE 7/4, CEE 7/7)
description: Household plug and socket system with two round 4.8 mm pins and earthing through side clips and strips. Unpolarised: the plug can be inserted either way. The CEE 7/7 hybrid plug also fits type E (CEE 7/5) sockets.

variants.name: CEE 7/3 socket-outlet

contacts.label: PE
contacts.note: Two earthing clips on the recess wall; they engage before the line contacts.

variants.keying: None: the socket is symmetric and accepts the plug either way.
mechanicalNotes: Recessed socket; the two pin holes are 19 mm apart on a horizontal line.
Earthing clips sit at 12 and 6 o'clock on the recess wall, 16 mm from the midpoint between the pin holes.
Recess depth differs between secondary sources (15 mm or 17.5 mm) and is not recorded.

variants.keying: None: unpolarised, can be inserted either way.

contacts.note: Receives the earth pin of a type E (CEE 7/5) socket.

variants.keying: In a CEE 7/3 socket it is unpolarised; in a CEE 7/5 socket the earth pin enforces one orientation.
mechanicalNotes: Combines the earthing strips of CEE 7/4 with the earth hole of CEE 7/6.

Frequency is not stated by the cited sources.

The CEE 7/7 plug face is drawn from two manufacturer front views (International Configurations 70142, pro-ELEC ECS002-SHU): 36.5 mm face with flats 32 mm apart and guide ribs, pins 19 mm apart, earthing strips top and bottom, earth hole below the pin line. The earth hole offset is scaled from the 70142 drawing, not dimensioned; the CEE 7/7 standard sheet was not reviewed.
No CEE 7/4 plug drawing: no source found depicts the face of a plain CEE 7/4 plug with dimensions, and it is not derived from the CEE 7/7 drawing or by mirroring the socket.
